description: Full-frame text on the dark brand background: a big punchline or number, a chapter title, or a clearly marked placeholder for a meme you still need to add.

fields.text: The text. *word* = highlight color, \n = new line
fields.variant: big (default: huge text), chapter (section title with a glitch shadow) or placeholder (yellow dashed card describing an asset to add later; name the file NN-placeholder-<what>.png and the rough cut swaps in NN-<what>.<ext> once it exists)
fields.color: Highlight color for *words* (hex, default brand accent)
